raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-16 change note says v2 emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, but silver_transactions treats both as local. v2 rows (collector='v2') are therefore shifted about 6 hours late, which pushes midnight-to-6am UTC rows into the next business date and produces the spurious 00:00-06:00 timestamps and the 41-row 2026-01-19 volume spike. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver_transactions fixes the dates, and the gold tables are rebuilt from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS WITH t AS (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST((CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS local_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, local_ts AS txn_ts, CAST(local_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM t;"}}
